title: cxg-author-probe author cell-type picks (v0)
description: Output of the picker stage. One file per dataset; produced by a Claude Code sub-agent, an Anthropic-API call, or any other LLM driver — even a human. The schema does not constrain *who* produced the picks, only that they match the probe.

probe_ref.description: Path to the probe-v0 JSON this pick was derived from, or its content-hash. Used to detect schema drift before assembly.

picks.description: Obs column names selected as author cell-type fields. Empty array is valid — means 'no author cell-type column present in this dataset'.

reasoning.description: One-sentence justification, for audit and disagreement triage.

model.description: Model identifier, e.g. 'claude-sonnet-4-6'. Empty for non-LLM kinds.

version.description: Picker prompt version or package version that produced this pick.
